title: It Is Necessary That: What the Region Should Do

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *es necesario que*, *es importante que* and *es mejor que* from A2 Unit 27. After a value judgment about what others should do, the verb after *que* is in the present subjunctive. Debates about refugees and migration use them all the time: what governments, border offices and schools should provide.

items.spanish: Es necesario que los países den documentos a las personas que llegan.
items.english: It is necessary that countries give papers to the people who arrive.

items.spanish: Es importante que los niños migrantes vayan a la escuela.
items.english: It is important that migrant children go to school.

items.spanish: Es mejor que los trámites sean claros y rápidos.
items.english: It is better that the paperwork is clear and quick.

items.spanish: Es una lástima que haya tantas familias sin ayuda.
items.english: It is a pity that so many families are without help.

sections.content: When the idea is general, use the infinitive: *Es importante dar documentos*. When it names who should do it, use *que* and the subjunctive: *Es importante que los países den documentos*.
